question: How is the six-limb ritual procedure constituted using klīṃ seed syllables?
premises: The klīṃ bīja syllables are used.
The syllables are endowed with six long modifications.
inference: The six-limb procedure is performed with klīṃ seed syllables endowed with six long forms.
plain_english: Thus is the six-limb procedure with klīṃ seed syllables endowed with the six long vowels.
